_about: Risk rules for jax 0.11.x. 'unsafe' = disk/network/host-callback; 'safe' = vetted pure-compute, whose note flags any residual output-channel risk to review in combination (kept deliberately vague). Cross-library rules in _common/default are merged in on top of these. This is advisory, not a proof.

safe.jax.lax: Module reference, present so deep-path calls (jax.lax.rsqrt) resolve. Does NOT permit calling other jax.lax members (exact-path match, not a glob).
safe.jax.lax.rsqrt: Reciprocal square root. Pure; some residual output-channel risk — review in combination.
safe.jax.nn: Module reference, present so deep-path calls (jax.nn.softmax / gelu) resolve. Does NOT permit calling other jax.nn members.
safe.jax.nn.gelu: GELU activation. Pure; residual output-channel risk only.
safe.jax.nn.softmax: Softmax activation. Pure, required for attention; residual output-channel risk — review in combination.
safe.jax.numpy.arange: Integer range generator. Pure; produces constants, no secret enters.
safe.jax.numpy.array: Materializes input into an array. Pure; low residual risk — review in context.
safe.jax.numpy.bool_: Cast to boolean. Pure; residual output-channel risk only.
safe.jax.numpy.concatenate: Joins arrays along an axis. Pure; residual output-shaping risk — review in combination.
safe.jax.numpy.cos: Element-wise cosine. Pure; residual output-channel risk only.
safe.jax.numpy.einsum: Einstein-summation contraction. Pure math, required for attention and projections; very expressive, so it carries the most residual output-channel risk — bound output entropy at the enclave and review in combination.
safe.jax.numpy.float32: Cast to float32. Pure; residual output-channel risk only.
safe.jax.numpy.mean: Reduction to a mean. Pure; residual risk via the returned value only.
safe.jax.numpy.repeat: Repeats elements. Pure; residual output-shaping risk — review in combination.
safe.jax.numpy.sin: Element-wise sine. Pure; residual output-channel risk only.
safe.jax.numpy.sqrt: Element-wise square root. Pure; some residual output-channel risk — review in combination.
safe.jax.numpy.square: Element-wise square. Pure; no channel of its own (a statistic amplifier, e.g. in RMSNorm).
safe.jax.numpy.transpose: Reorders axes. Pure; residual output-shaping risk only.
safe.jax.numpy.tril: Lower-triangular mask. Pure; builds attention masks (compositional, low bandwidth).
safe.jax.numpy.where: Element-wise conditional select. Pure; residual output-channel risk — review in combination.

unsafe.jax.debug.*: Debug host callbacks / stdout (jax.debug.print, jax.debug.callback) — runs host Python and writes to the process stdout.
unsafe.jax.distributed.*: Multi-host coordination — opens outbound network connections to a coordinator address.
unsafe.jax.dlpack.*: Hands raw device buffers to other frameworks (interop escape hatch).
unsafe.jax.experimental.*: Experimental surface — includes io_callback, export, and array_serialization (writes arrays to disk and gs:// cloud storage).
unsafe.jax.numpy.save*: Serializes array(s) to disk (save / savez / savez_compressed / savetxt).
unsafe.jax.profiler.*: Profiler — writes trace / memory-profile files to disk (logdir accepts gs://), and start_server opens a network listener.
unsafe.jax.pure_callback: Runs an arbitrary host Python callback during execution.
